title: Check that the published centre columns cancel
body:
## Summary
- Ports `(0, 6, 85)` have columns `(1,1,1,1,0,0,0,0)`, `(0,1,1,0,1,0,0,1)` and `(1,0,0,1,-1,0,0,-1)`, and `R_0 - R_6 - R_85 = 0`.
- The per-owner factor is `112 - 8 = 104`. The even subgroup has order `16 · 15 · 17 = 4080`, so the block has `104 · 4080 = 424320` coordinates and the common kernel saves one of them.
- The published census splits 896 triples into 56 of order 4080 and 840 larger ones. With the published 15-owner floor, the support lies in `[15, 4080]`. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/centre-column-relation/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/centre-column-relation/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-column-relation`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on canonical main
